cards.ex: Businesses need to move with the times to stay competitive.
cards.exUz: Korxonalar raqobatbardosh bo'lish uchun zamonga moslashishlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan o'zgarishlarga moslashish, yangi narsalarni qabul qilish.

cards.ex: The company has made great strides in improving customer service.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya mijozlarga xizmat ko'rsatishni yaxshilashda katta muvaffaqiyatlarga erishdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror sohada sezilarli yutuqlarga erishish, yaxshilanish.

cards.ex: He had a change of heart and decided to support the project.
cards.exUz: U fikrini o'zgartirdi va loyihani qo'llab-quvvatlashga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Oldingi fikrdan butunlay boshqacha fikrga kelish, pozitsiyani o'zgartirish.

cards.ex: This ruling could set a precedent for future cases.
cards.exUz: Bu qaror kelajakdagi ishlar uchun namuna yaratishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Kelajak uchun qoida yoki andoza yaratuvchi yangi holatni yaratish.

cards.ex: After a slow start, the economy is now on the upswing.
cards.exUz: Sekin boshlanganidan so'ng, iqtisodiyot hozir ko'tarilishda.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshilanish, o'sish yoki yuksalish holatida bo'lish.

cards.ex: She broke the mold and became a successful female entrepreneur.
cards.exUz: U stereotiplarni buzdi va muvaffaqiyatli ayol tadbirkorga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Odatiy yoki an'anaviy uslubdan voz kechish, yangicha yo'l tutish.

cards.ex: This new policy is a step in the right direction for environmental protection.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi siyosat atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish uchun to'g'ri yo'nalishda qadamdir.
cards.term: a step in the right direction
cards.uzDef: Yaxshilanish tomon qo'yilgan birinchi qadam, ijobiy o'zgarish.

cards.ex: The city center has been transformed beyond recognition in recent years.
cards.exUz: So'nggi yillarda shahar markazi tanib bo'lmas darajada o'zgardi.
cards.uzDef: Shunchalik katta o'zgarishki, avvalgi holatini tanib bo'lmaydi.

cards.ex: The company is trying to cultivate a culture of innovation.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya innovatsiyalar madaniyatini rivojlantirishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan xatti-harakatlar yoki e'tiqodlarni rag'batlantiradigan muhit yaratish.

cards.ex: The campaign to raise awareness about climate change is gathering momentum.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishi haqida xabardorlikni oshirish kampaniyasi kuchayib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Tezlashmoq, kuchayib bormoq, rivojlanish tezligini oshirmoq.

cards.ex: The election was a watershed moment in the country's history.
cards.exUz: Saylov mamlakat tarixidagi burilish nuqtasi bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Muhim o'zgarishlarga olib keladigan muhim voqea yoki davr.

cards.ex: Education can help break down barriers between different social groups.
cards.exUz: Ta'lim turli ijtimoiy guruhlar o'rtasidagi to'siqlarni olib tashlashga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: O'zaro aloqaga xalaqit beradigan to'siqlarni yo'q qilish.

cards.ex: Scientists are constantly pushing the boundaries of what is possible.
cards.exUz: Olimlar doimiy ravishda imkoniyat chegaralarini kengaytirishga harakat qilmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Mavjud bilimlarning yoki imkoniyatlarning chegaralarini kengaytirishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Developing a new product is often a process of trial and error.
cards.exUz: Yangi mahsulotni ishlab chiqish ko'pincha xato va tajriba jarayonidir.
cards.term: a process of trial and error
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilishning xato va tuzatishlar orqali amalga oshiriladigan usuli.

cards.ex: She rose through the ranks to become CEO of the company.
cards.exUz: U mansab pillapoyalaridan ko'tarilib, kompaniya bosh direktori bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Quyi lavozimlardan boshlab yuqori lavozimlarga ko'tarilish.

cards.ex: There has been a significant shift in public opinion on this issue.
cards.exUz: Bu masala bo'yicha jamoatchilik fikrida muhim o'zgarish bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Katta va sezilarli o'zgarish, burilish.

cards.ex: The new manager was able to turn the failing company around.
cards.exUz: Yangi menejer muvaffaqiyatsiz kompaniyani o'zgartira oldi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon vaziyatni yaxshi tomonga o'zgartirish, yaxshilash.

cards.ex: The team decided to adopt a new approach to the project.
cards.exUz: Jamoa loyihaga yangi yondashuvni qabul qilishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilish yoki maqsadga erishish uchun yangi usulni qo'llash.

cards.ex: Investing in education will reap dividends in the future.
cards.exUz: Ta'limga sarmoya kiritish kelajakda natijasini beradi.
cards.uzDef: Qilingan ishlar, harakatlar natijasida foyda ko'rmoq.

cards.ex: The company is on the cusp of launching a new product.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yangi mahsulotni ishga tushirish arafasida.
cards.uzDef: Yangi bosqich yoki voqea boshlanishi arafasida bo'lish.

cards.ex: Technology is advancing in leaps and bounds.
cards.exUz: Texnologiya katta qadamlar bilan rivojlanmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Tez va katta o'sish, rivojlanish.

cards.ex: After the initial setback, the team had to shift gears to succeed.
cards.exUz: Dastlabki muvaffaqiyatsizlikdan so'ng, jamoa muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun uslubni o'zgartirishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Faoliyat yoki yondashuvni birdan o'zgartirish, boshqa uslubga o'tish.

cards.ex: After considering the evidence, I had to rethink my position on the issue.
cards.exUz: Dalillarni ko'rib chiqqandan so'ng, men bu masala bo'yicha o'z pozitsiyamni qayta ko'rib chiqishim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: O'z nuqtai nazaringizni, pozitsiyangizni qayta baholash, o'zgartirish ehtimolini ko'rib chiqish.

cards.ex: He finally saw the light and realized he was wrong.
cards.exUz: U nihoyat haqiqatni angladi va xato qilganini tushundi.
cards.uzDef: Xato fikrdan voz kechish, to'g'ri yo'lni topish, haqiqatni anglash.

cards.ex: The country is undergoing a gradual transition to democracy.
cards.exUz: Mamlakat demokratiyaga asta-sekin o'tish jarayonini boshidan kechirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Sekin-asta, bosqichma-bosqich o'zgarish jarayoni.

cards.ex: The new technology is rewriting the rules of the game.
cards.exUz: Yangi texnologiya o'yin qoidalarini qayta yozmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Mavjud qoidalarni o'zgartirish, yangi qoidalar yaratish.

cards.ex: Investigating the issue might open a can of worms.
cards.exUz: Bu masalani tekshirish yangi muammolarni keltirib chiqarishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Bilmastdan yangi va murakkab muammolarni keltirib chiqarmoq.

cards.ex: The new technology represents a quantum leap in efficiency.
cards.exUz: Yangi texnologiya samaradorlikda kvant sakrashini anglatadi.
cards.uzDef: Katta va birdaniga bo'ladigan o'zgarish, sezilarli yuksalish.

cards.ex: The two companies are on a collision course over market share.
cards.exUz: Ikki kompaniya bozor ulushi uchun to'qnashuv yo'lida.
cards.uzDef: O'zaro ziddiyatga yoki mojaroga olib keladigan yo'nalishda harakatlanish.

cards.ex: The research laid the groundwork for future discoveries.
cards.exUz: Tadqiqot kelajakdagi kashfiyotlar uchun asos yaratdi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda biror narsaning rivojlanishi uchun shart-sharoit yaratish, poydevor qo'yish.
